evidence: The HfAlO composite ﬁlms were formed by alternative cyclic depositions of HfO 2 and Al 2O3. The postdeposition annealing (PDA) was carried out in an N 2 ambient at 600 ◦C for 1 min by rapid thermal annealing. The TaN gate electrode was formed by sputtering. The physical thicknesses of Al 2O3,H f A l O , and HfO 2 were 5, 6.2, and 7.2 nm, respectively, measured by high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (TEM) after completion of the device fabrication. In order to investigate the interface between high- κ and GaAs, another set of samples with very thin high- κ dielectric layers, which is formed only by ten cycles in the ALD process, was prepared using the same process recipe.
